title: Per-vector billing catalog + enterprise QSA readiness for embeddings & rerank
creator: Ava Chen
description:
Summary: Define and run per-vector unit economics experiments for embeddings and reranking, build a batch-discount catalog and contract language for enterprise, and produce QSA/contract artifacts that map the new billing primitives to security and audit controls.

Context: We need clearer unit pricing for embeddings and rerank requests that matches observed costs across workloads. Current per-call pricing obscures marginal cost differences for large batch jobs (bulk embeddings, offline rerank pipelines). Enterprise customers and procurement require a contract-friendly billing model (per-vector + optional batch discounts, committed SLAs). Security and procurement teams also require QSA artifacts that explain how usage meters are computed, how sensitive data is handled in billable telemetry, and what audit trails exist.

Goals:
- Design per-vector and per-rerank unit prices and a batch discount schedule that reflect runtime economics while remaining competitive.
- Implement a pricing catalog entry and a price simulator for finance/solutions engineering.
- Update enterprise contract templates with explicit billing language, metering definitions, and audit clauses.
- Complete QSA/SSQ sections impacted by billing telemetry (data minimization, PII handling in logs, encrypted exports).

Out of scope: changes to model inference algorithms, large-scale price list overhaul for non-embedding products (handled separately).
acceptance_criteria: Per-vector and per-rerank price tiers documented in pricing catalog (public internal draft).
Batch-discount schedule implemented in the price simulator and validated against 3 customer workload samples.
Billing telemetry events from ENG-4125 provide per-vector counts and batch identifiers to Finance for verification.
Updated enterprise contract clause (billing section) checked into legal templates and approved by Legal (PM-8702 sign-off).
QSA artifact set completed: mapping doc, SSQ answers for billing telemetry, and sample logs with redaction guidance.
Console shows example billing breakdown for a sample monthly invoice (token vs vector vs rerank lines).
Release notes and outbound comms plan drafted for customers and sales (solutions kits).
tasks: Define experimental price points and discount breakpoints (PM lead + Finance)
Segment customer cohorts for A/B and pricing pilot (by monthly vector volume)
Instrument billing events: add vector_count, rerank_count, batch_id to meter payloads (ENG-4125)
Build price simulator spreadsheet and a small interactive tool for sales (link in links)
Draft enterprise contract language for metering and auditability (Legal review request)
Prepare QSA mapping: what telemetry is stored, retention, encryption, and access controls
Frontend: console mockups for per-vector line items and example invoice pages
Run pilot with 2 existing enterprise customers (solutions + CSM coordination)
comments: 2026-03-10 Ava Chen: Kickoff. Aligned with Finance on target unit economics ranges (0.0002–0.0006 USD per vector depending on batch). Agreed to test a 3-tier batch discount (0–1M vectors, 1M–10M, 10M+). Added dependencies on ENG-4125 for telemetry and ENG-4180 for console UI changes.

2026-03-11 Diego Martinez: Reached out to Solutions to identify 4 candidate customers for the pilot. Solutions recommended two enterprise customers with heavy offline embedding jobs and one data-platform customer using rerank at scale.

2026-03-11 Priya Singh (Finance): Ran cost model sensitivity. Key trade-offs: deeper discounts increase churn risk if prices too aggressive; need a minimum monthly commitment option to protect unit economics for Dedicated customers.

2026-03-12 Miguel Alvarez (Legal): Drafted billing clause that defines 'billable vector' and 'rerank invocation' and includes a clause for meter dispute resolution. Uploaded draft to PR linked above. Requested PM to supply sample invoices for language validation.

2026-03-12 Jordan Li (Security): Reviewed telemetry plan. Action items: ensure vector payloads are not stored in billing logs, apply field-level redaction, and add KMS envelope encryption to any exported billing CSVs. Security requested QSA mapping doc by 2026-03-18.

2026-03-13 Diego Martinez: Updated acceptance criteria to include QSA artifact completion. Mockups exist in Figma. Next: prioritize ENG-4125 patch to include batch_id and vector_count by end of next sprint.
